result.summary: The page is largely functional and well laid out. The main visible defects are a minor decorative graphic on the promo banner that is awkwardly clipped at the edge, and a minor concern around the truncated delivery address and its unclear chevron affordance.

issues.description: The promotional banner has a large, awkwardly clipped translucent circle/shape on the right side that appears cut off and visually unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Adjust or remove the decorative shapes so they stay within the banner bounds and blend more naturally with the background.

issues.description: The address line for the delivery location is truncated to 'Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn' and the chevron control next to it appears non-functional, making it unclear whether the full address can be viewed or changed.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the address displays fully or is intentionally ellipsized, and make the chevron clearly tappable to open the address picker.
